title: C2O4²⁻-templated cage-shaped Ln28 (Ln = Gd, Eu) nanoclusters with magnetocaloric effect and luminescence

synthesis.procedure: HIN, Gd2O3, Al2O3 and KBr were placed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave; HCOOH and distilled water were added. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 12 h, adjusted from pH 4.8 to 2.0 with 50% HNO3 under stirring, then heated at 170 °C for 7 days. After cooling to approximately room temperature, light-yellow quadrilateral crystals were collected and washed with distilled water.

properties.summary: Weak antiferromagnetic interactions were inferred from the temperature-dependent susceptibility and Curie–Weiss fit. The cluster exhibits a magnetocaloric effect.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete oxalate-templated cage comprises a Gd12 subunit assembled from four triangular Gd3 units and a Gd16 subunit assembled from four cubane-like Gd4 units. Six oxalate anions link and template the framework, which is further stabilized by isonicotinate and formate groups.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the explicitly reported Gd28 procedure, replacing Gd2O3 with Eu2O3: HIN, Eu2O3, Al2O3 and KBr were combined in a 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave with HCOOH and distilled water, stirred at room temperature for 12 h, adjusted from pH 4.8 to 2.0 with 50% HNO3, and heated at 170 °C for 7 days. Light-yellow quadrilateral crystals were obtained after cooling and washing with distilled water.

properties.summary: Solid-state Eu(III) luminescence was observed at room temperature. Emission was assigned to Eu(III) ⁵D₀→⁷FJ transitions; the absence of a strong broad ligand emission band was interpreted as an antenna effect.
